title: 玉色折枝
detail: Jade-green silk-jacquard calf qipao-inspired dress with an original low stand collar, offset curved front fastening and broad petal cap sleeve, restrained black geometric branch jacquard placed only at shoulder and hem, black flat pointed shoes. Rework collar, seam and original pattern without dragons or copied motifs.

title: 朱红折领
detail: Vermilion structured cropped box jacket with a crisp modest standing collar and original diagonal cutwork panels over opaque ivory lining, ivory very wide full-length tailored trousers and black low sculptural shoes. Transfer researched embroidery/clean tailoring into a fresh jacket-and-trouser qipao vocabulary, no copied chain belt.

title: 石蓝叠影
detail: Slate-blue dense silk-wool long wrapped coat dress with a folded high neckline, a broad asymmetrically draped umber side panel and long straight sleeves, ivory narrow ankle trousers peeking under front opening, dark brown squared low shoes. Restrained layered volume and diagonal wrap, original panel architecture.

title: 天蓝空隙
detail: Sky-blue linen oversized sleeveless long shirt tunic with a wide folded square collar, two large side slits and asymmetric long front tab, white sculptural barrel ankle trousers, natural woven flat sandals. Redesign relaxed linen into shoulder geometry and curved lower volume, not plain shirt-and-pants.

title: 海军蓝软岛
detail: Deep navy very cropped cashmere-like cocoon cardigan with oversized balloon elbows and one low original asymmetric button, cream rib ankle column skirt with a broad rust waistband wrap, navy low suede mules. Recompose short soft knit versus long column and changed closure, no exact product copy.
